rows.headline: Nutanix sinks 15% after beating its targets and announcing that its chief executive will step down
rows.summary: Nutanix fell 15.2% to $46.30 after reporting first-quarter revenue up 15% to $772 million and a record 32.1% adjusted operating margin, alongside the news that the board has begun searching for a successor to chief executive Rajiv Ramaswami.

rows.headline: Kanzhun climbs 12.6% as BOSS Zhipin grows users 14% and announces a new $500 million buyback
rows.summary: Kanzhun, operator of China’s BOSS Zhipin job platform, rose 12.6% to $14.34 after third-quarter revenue grew 11.7% to RMB2.42 billion, monthly users rose 14.4% to 73 million and the board approved a new $500 million share buyback.

rows.headline: HP jumps 11.5% as results and a cautious outlook prove better than investors had feared
rows.summary: HP rose 11.5% to $31.15 the day after reporting fourth-quarter revenue up 9.3% to $16.0 billion, guiding fiscal 2027 adjusted EPS of $3.15–3.45 and raising its quarterly dividend to $0.31. Adjusted quarterly EPS fell 10.8% as memory costs hit PC margins.

rows.headline: Li Auto rises 11% as its loss narrows sharply and it expects a return to profit this quarter
rows.summary: Li Auto gained 11.0% to $11.88 after third-quarter revenue rose 5.4% to RMB28.8 billion, above its own guidance, the net loss shrank to RMB310 million from RMB1.7 billion in the second quarter, and the company said it expects to be profitable again in the fourth quarter.

rows.headline: Urban Outfitters falls 10% despite record third-quarter sales and earnings per share
rows.summary: Urban Outfitters dropped 10.3% to $76.74 after reporting record third-quarter sales of $1.67 billion, up 8.9%, and EPS of $1.54 against $1.28. Retail comparable sales grew 4.4%, with Anthropologie up only 1.7%, while inventory rose 10.1%.
